intro.title: Create Talking Avatar Videos From a Portrait and Voice

content.title: What is an AI talking avatar?
content.text: An AI talking avatar turns a still portrait into a short speaking video. The uploaded audio controls the mouth movement while the prompt guides expression, head motion, lighting, and camera feel.

content.title: When to use it
content.text: Use it when you need a presenter-style video but do not want to film a new take. It works best with one clear face, one clean audio track, and a focused prompt.

content.title: What to prepare
content.text: Start with a front-facing portrait and a short speech clip. Avoid noisy audio, covered mouths, side-profile faces, and long scripts that need scene changes.

faq.q: What is an AI talking avatar creator?
faq.a: It creates a short speaking video from a portrait image and an audio file. The audio drives speech timing while the prompt controls expression and presentation style.
Use a clear front-facing portrait with good lighting and an unobstructed mouth. Avoid side profiles, sunglasses, heavy blur, or cropped faces.

faq.q: Can I use my own voice?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a voice audio file you have the rights to use. Short, clean speech with one speaker usually gives better lip sync.
